representative_rules: First saved SPATIAL R2/T20 paired state with more available pairs than max_pairs
First saved BOTTLENECK R4/T40 paired state with more available pairs than max_pairs
First recorded reference-kernel call on BOTTLENECK R4/T40, fixed 40 iterations, seed 23, with six pooled tasks
diagnostic_rule: Force each eligible pair first in a separate one-pair kernel run; same depth, per-pair beams, two selected leaves, greedy incumbent/tail and one-pass LS. Extra offline work, never an equal-budget deployment score.
revision_gate: At least one diagnosed state has a strictly better post-LS forced pair missed by reference and both old policies, and one normal two-pair counterfactual ranking realizes that improvement. This is supervised development opportunity, not general superiority.
stop_rule: No model call unless actionable ranking opportunity is found. At most two evaluated revisions; no automatic retries; at most one engineering fix per candidate within six charged requests.
